name: anstar-business-central
description: Staged Business Central read adapter with personal Microsoft sign-in.

interface.longDescription: Anstar-owned TypeScript adapter to Microsoft's hosted Business Central MCP, using Microsoft MSAL sign-in and read-only dynamic discovery. Requires Node.js 22+ and npm/npx; dependencies install automatically. Preview remains disabled pending adapter and desktop acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Check whether the Business Central read-only connection is ready.
Find the available Business Central APIs for my question without changing any records.
